Use case: logo-brand. Create a NEW independently drawn standalone ornate Russian fairy-tale game logo, using the supplied FULL Home screenshot only as visual reference, not as pixels to extract, crop, mask, trace or reuse. Output one isolated logo on actual alpha-transparent background; no scenery or UI page.
Match the reference's upper-central logo faithfully: broad almost-black carved lacquer shield with intricately scrolling deep antique-gold acanthus branches forming horizontal wings, large faceted sapphire jewel in a peaked floral crown at top, little diamond sapphire pendant below. EXACT Cyrillic lettering in three lines: "ЛЕГЕНДЫ" on top, very large "РУСИ" in middle, "ТРИ В РЯД" in a separate royal-navy horizontal nameplate beneath. All letters uppercase, engraved ornate historic serif in warm aged gold, strong counters. Main word РУСИ occupies most height. NO castle silhouette; no alternative mixed-case Splash brand layout. The black center has subtly carved leaf pattern. Silhouette and letter positions closely match the reference, wider than tall, visual aspect 1.48:1. Entire crest visible with 2% empty safety margin.
Color matching: deep brown gold shadows #563410, gold midtones #aa7932, narrow bright brass bevels #dfb65f; central lacquer #0b0c0b and nameplate #071b2a, rich cobalt sapphires. Dark polished antique surfaces, not yellow plastic or ivory lettering, NO bloom or white glare. Recreate all edges and ornaments with fresh rendering. Transparent PNG, no checkerboard illustration, no external background shadow.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW independent illustration of Ivan and his Firebird together as ONE isolated game foreground character sprite on actual alpha-transparent background. The attached FULL original Home screenshot is a reference for pose, facial identity, clothing, colors and rendering only. Do NOT extract, crop, mask, paste, or reuse screenshot pixels. Paint the subject anew without ANY background scenery or interface.
Recreate the screenshot's central character: handsome young CLEAN-SHAVEN Slavic prince Ivan, fair subtly warm skin, wavy medium brown hair, calm strong face looking upward to viewer's right. Three-quarter torso, blue eyes, deep sapphire/navy embroidered tunic with antique-gold vine embroidery and sunburst round chest medallion; dark crimson velvet cloak draped across both shoulders and flowing broadly down and toward lower left. No beard, no fur collar, no leather harness. Body turned slightly right, depicted from head through hips, full garment silhouette visible. A large graceful Firebird perches on his LEFT shoulder (viewer's right), head facing LEFT toward Ivan, elegant slightly curved neck, closed layered orange-gold wings and long flowing copper-orange tail sweeping downward and right, with several jewel eyespots near tailtips. Bird head is just higher than Ivan's shoulder, beside his face; not flying. Match individual feather filigree and original poised warm expression. Ivan head located approx38%width,12%height; birdhead65%width,19%height. Complete combined silhouette occupies94%canvas, portrait3:4 proportion. No flat hard cut at sides, cloak hem and feather ends fully visible, no detached silhouette bits.
Match original deep materials exactly in spirit: robe #092044 to #173962 with gold #9c712e, cloak shadows #25090b to mids #761b16, skin realistically shaded with small sunset highlights; bird deep #863000 and #d77111 with restricted #ecaa3c accents. Strong warm side/rim light from viewer-right, dark blue shadow side, no blanket exposure lift, NO pure white or pale yellow blown highlights, NO bloom, no neon. Painterly realistic high-end Russian fantasy illustration. Real transparent alpha outside figure including holes, no sky/snow/buildings/ground, no logo/button/text/frame, no checkerboard. Do not alter the reference background because it is NOT part of this asset.
